description.value:
You often spend your time in the Communion Vaults at the Lorespire Complex, performing magical divinations or experiments for the Starfinder Society. Perhaps you train under the enigmatic Starfinder Nykiti Lampadephoros or transcribe the dreams of Whisper of Solar Winds, a slumbering Liavaran Dreamer.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Arcana skill and the Fortune-Telling Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Arcane Sense] skill feat.
